items.title: VideoAmp Bets On AI To Connect Ad Planning And Measurement
items.excerpt: With its JIC re-certification in hand, VideoAmp is pushing AI agents to connect TV planning and measurement so buyers can optimize campaigns in flight. Note: no named product or customer data; measurement angle (under-covered).

items.title: Meta named a future that never came. Amazon Ads Agent names one that exists
items.excerpt: Analysis of Amazon retiring the Amazon DSP name (now DVA) and merging the ads console and DSP into the agentic Amazon Ads Agent; argues the real test is its fees. Retail media AI; the launch itself was Sept 29 at unBoxed, so this is analysis, not a new launch.

items.title: Google Ads PM says target or budget changes cause no learning period
items.excerpt: Google Ads PM Tal Akabas said Smart Bidding now scales bids proportionally to new targets on steady campaigns without re-entering learning; a re-engagement mode reaches PMax first, with Search and Shopping next.

items.title: Meta's Muse gains a 33% share of AI browser traffic in 9 days, DataDome finds
items.excerpt: DataDome counted 29.1M Muse agent requests in 12 days, 99.3% from Cloudflare and Fastly rather than home ISPs, testing merchants' bot rules. Follow-up to the HUMAN '72% of agent traffic' story already covered; new vendor data only.

items.title: Meta removes language that raised scraping and AI training concerns
items.excerpt: Meta struck the Commercial Terms language that suggested it could crawl websites 'associated with' business/advertiser accounts to train AI, after backlash; a spokesperson said crawling practice hasn't changed. New decision following the 10-17 Meta crawl-terms card.

items.title: 네이버·카카오·구글·메타가 제시한 AI 광고의 미래… 마케터는 무엇을 준비해야 하나
items.excerpt: 한국디지털광고협회 'AI 광고마케팅 패스트트랙 세미나'(10/15)에서 네이버(AI 검색과 검색광고 변화), 카카오(광고 데이터 맥락 연결), 구글(목표·데이터 기반 최적화), 메타(구매 여정 전반 AI)가 AI 광고 전략과 솔루션을 공유했다.

items.title: "AI로 기사만 쓰는 시대는 지났다" 미디어 기업들, AI로 구독 늘리고 광고 효율 높인다
items.excerpt: 영국 AOP 'Publishing Tech Talk 2026' 보고서: 옵저버, LADbible, 이코노미스트, 텔레그래프 등이 AI를 서비스 개발·독자 관리·광고 운영에 써서 구독과 광고 수익을 늘린 사례. 퍼블리셔 측 광고 판매 AI 활용.

items.title: "흩어진 고객 데이터를 하나로" AI·개인정보 보호 강화에 주목받는 '아이덴티티 레졸루션'
items.excerpt: MarTech 2026 보고서 기반: 광고 식별자 제한과 개인정보 규제 속에 기기·채널별 고객 데이터를 AI로 연결하는 아이덴티티 레졸루션이 개인화 광고와 성과 측정의 기반으로 부상. 1st-party data 활성화(덜 다룬 키워드); 보고서 요약 기사.

items.title: Inside Wirecutter's push to diversify beyond affiliate revenue as AI reshapes discovery
items.excerpt: As AI answers erode search-driven product discovery, NYT's Wirecutter is expanding beyond affiliate commerce into new categories, franchises and advertising opportunities.

items.title: Websites are closing their doors to AI agents
items.excerpt: Sites and retailers increasingly block AI agents with bot walls and terms, undermining the agentic-shopping narrative. Overlaps the earlier 'commerce platforms block AI agents' card; check cross-section (gadgets/politics).

items.title: What marketers need to know from Advertising Week New York 2026
items.excerpt: Takeaways from AWNY with Smirnoff, Liquid Death and Chili's: the evolving role of AI in advertising, reaching Gen Z/Gen Alpha and creator-marketing cost efficiency. Conference roundup; AI is one of several themes.

items.title: More Than Three Quarters of Small Business Owners Say AI Makes Them More Productive, But Most Need More Guidance
items.excerpt: Meta research across nine APAC markets on how small businesses use AI to grow, compete and reach customers across borders; most say they need more guidance. Vendor survey.

items.title: ChatGPT Traffic Drop Appears To Be A Tracking Problem
items.excerpt: ChatGPT-attributed referral traffic fell sharply in several analytics datasets this month; analysts tie it to ChatGPT links opening without tracking tags, an attribution issue for marketers measuring AI-driven visits. Not paid placement; borderline scope.
